EventLogPosition.description: Validated position immediately before a canonical record (or after the header).

event_hash.description: Hash of the preceding record or header.

file_offset.description: Byte offset of the next record in the canonical stream.

monotonic_ns.description: Timestamp of the preceding record, or zero at the header.

description:
Catalog entry for one engine checkpoint.

The frame holds the checkpointed state's record and an exact libghostty-vt engine snapshot,
so any later position can be rebuilt by restoring it and replaying up to that position.

control_index_offset.description: Byte offset of the first control-index entry at or after the checkpointed state.

control_rank.description: Number of control entries ordered before the checkpointed state.

event_byte_offset.description: Inclusive output byte offset of the checkpointed state inside its event.

event_seq.description: Canonical event responsible for the checkpointed state.

hidden_before.description: Number of hidden boundary states before the checkpointed state.

length.description: Compressed byte length of that frame.

monotonic_ns.description: Monotonic timestamp of the checkpointed state in nanoseconds.

offset.description: Byte offset of the checkpoint's zstd frame in the binary checkpoint member.

presented.description: Whether the checkpointed state was eligible for presentation.

source_position.description: Event-log position of the checkpointed state's event, where replay can resume.

state_id.description: Stream position of the checkpointed state.

state_rank.description: Number of boundary states before the checkpointed state.

timeline_rank.description: Combined semantic/effect/canonical/control timeline rank of the checkpointed state.

title: SemanticReplayCheckpoint
